stage: first stability validation of the simplest KEEP candidate R1 (Linear Residual Adapter)
paper_phase: from method screening to first stability validation
thesis_served: 验证 R1 在不同随机种子下是否仍能稳定提升 Bird/Car/Cube 的 AUROC 与 AP
why_now: E13-A seed0 R1: mean dAUROC +0.01540 / mean dAP +0.01171, 3/3 categories positive; must rule out single-seed luck

frozen_inputs.candidate: R1 Linear Residual Adapter only (z' = z + W z, 768->768)

seed_rule.bank_seed: bank = sorted(random.Random(20261009 + seed).sample(pool, 300))  (project unified rule BANK_SUBSET_SEED=20261009)
seed_rule.train_seed: torch.manual_seed(seed) + np.random.default_rng(seed) for adapter training batch sampling
seed_rule.note: adapter init is zero-init (identity), hence seed-independent; seed affects bank selection + batch order only

hyperparameters: strictly identical to E13-A R1: L=L_cons+0.1*L_preserve, AdamW lr=1e-3, mild brightness/contrast/gamma +/-15% (6 variants), max 300 steps, early-stop 30 (eval every 5), train 240/val 60

decision_rules.PASS: overall mean dAUROC >= +0.010 AND positive AUROC cells >= 7/9 AND per-category 3-seed mean dAUROC >= +0.005 AND overall mean dAP >= +0.005 AND no collapse
decision_rules.HOLD: overall mean dAUROC >= +0.0075 AND positive AUROC cells >= 6/9 AND per-category 3-seed mean dAUROC >= 0 AND overall mean dAP >= 0
